title: Amanhã e no mês que vem
grammar: Next week, tomorrow, next month para futuro
goal: Use tomorrow, next week e next month com going to para marcar quando algo vai acontecer.
reading: Nico is going to fly home tomorrow.
O Nico vai voar para casa amanhã.
He is going to come back next month.
Ele vai voltar no mês que vem.
June is going to meet him next week.
A June vai encontrá-lo na semana que vem.
They are going to have lunch at noon.
Next month, June is going to see his town.
No mês que vem, a June vai ver a cidade dele.
dialogue: When are you going to leave?
I am going to leave tomorrow.
When are you going to come back?
I am going to come back next month.
Vou voltar no mês que vem.
Is June going to meet you?
Yes, she is going to meet me next week.
Sim, ela vai me encontrar semana que vem.
So you are going home tomorrow?
Então você vai para casa amanhã?
Yes, and I am going to call you.
Sim, e vou ligar para você.
pron: A força cai na segunda sílaba: to-MOR-row.
gram: Com going to usamos tomorrow, não yesterday.
